prompt.vi: Viết hook useCounter(start) trả về [count, inc, dec]. App dùng nó: #c hiện số, #inc tăng, #dec giảm.
prompt.en: Write a useCounter(start) hook returning [count, inc, dec]. App uses it: #c shows the number, #inc increments, #dec decrements.

hint.vi: const [c, setC] = useState(start); return [c, () => setC(c + 1), () => setC(c - 1)];
hint.en: const [c, setC] = useState(start); return [c, () => setC(c + 1), () => setC(c - 1)];
